case.proofs: I have the signed rent agreement, bank transfer receipt of the deposit, and WhatsApp chats where he promised to return it.

steps.title: (General) Seek free legal advice or aid
steps.detail: Contact the District Legal Services Authority or call the legal aid helpline to understand your local options for recovering the rental deposit.
steps.where: District Legal Services Authority or NALSA Helpline 15100

steps.title: (General) Explore Lok Adalat for a settlement
steps.detail: Approach the pre-litigation Lok Adalat to attempt a quick and mutually agreed settlement with the landlord without going through a long court battle.
steps.where: District Legal Services Authority / Lok Adalat

steps.detail: If the landlord continues to ignore the demand, file a civil money recovery suit in the appropriate civil court within the limitation period.
steps.where: Civil Court having jurisdiction in Hyderabad

draft_document.text:
LEGAL NOTICE

To,
[LANDLORD'S NAME]
[LANDLORD'S ADDRESS]

Date: [DATE]

SUBJECT: DEMAND FOR REFUND OF SECURITY DEPOSIT OF RS 60,000

Dear Sir/Madam,

1. That you are the owner/landlord of the residential flat located at [FLAT ADDRESS, HYDERABAD], which the undersigned ([YOUR NAME]) occupied as a tenant pursuant to a signed rent agreement dated [DATE OF RENT AGREEMENT].

2. That at the commencement of the tenancy, the undersigned paid an amount of Rs 60,000 (Rupees Sixty Thousand Only) as a security deposit via bank transfer, receipt of which is duly documented.

3. That the undersigned vacated the said flat and handed over the possession and keys to you on 30 September 2026.

4. That despite vacating the premises cleanly and without any pending utility or rent dues, and despite several reminders and your subsequent WhatsApp messages promising to return the amount, you have failed to refund the security deposit of Rs 60,000 and are currently avoiding communication.

5. You are hereby called upon to refund the full security deposit amount of Rs 60,000 within 15 days of receiving this notice, failing which the undersigned will be forced to initiate appropriate legal proceedings, including filing a civil suit for recovery along with interest and costs, at your sole risk and expense.

Sincerely,

[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR CONTACT NUMBER]
[YOUR ADDRESS]
